activity.title: And just like that, the new academic year is here....Presenting the #BerkeleyMET #Classof2029 , our latest cohort of #changemakers ! I can't wait to see all that they accomplish as they embark on this exciting #journey . At our welcome event, I shared three things, in the hopes it'll set the right tone: 1. College is not about taking A, B, and C, to land jobs 1, 2, and 3. It's an opportunity to #discover what inspires you, and gain the #tools and #perspectives to pursue that #inspiration . 2. Part of that #experience is figuring out what you like and dislike, as well as what you're inherently strong at and what others may be better at. That sets the stage for your #career , and how to work together towards larger aspirations. 3. Along the way, know that there's an entire #community of faculty, staff, and peers to support you -- guiding you and cheering you on during your peaks as well as troughs. To all first-year students at universities near and far, now go #explore to find your #purpose and #fulfillment -- we're all rooting for you! #UCBerkeley #BerkeleyEngineering #BerkeleyHaas #College #University ...more ...more

Excited to share that I have won my very first in person hackathon! Last week I went with a couple of my friends in the UC Berkeley Management, Entrepreneurship, & Technology (M.E.T.) program to participate in the xAI + Vercel Hackathon at the xAI headquarters, where I teamed up with Ishita Samadhiya to create Xtravagant. Our idea was a create a new, efficient AI tool for users to visualize, interact, and analyze any type of data set. The judges loved our intuitive UI and use case for their products, and decided to award us as the winners of the AI Builder Track. Super grateful to the event organizers and judges for giving us this opportunity and recognizing our work as we were probably the youngest there by far. Excited for whats next! #ai #yay ...more ...more

Proud to be one of 13 founders in the first a16z Speedrun Alpha cohort. The program brought together deeply technical founders and pushed us hard on every aspect of company building. Extremely grateful to have been a part of it! At Locamage , we're building geospatial foundation models: AI that sees and understands the Earth from satellite imagery and other geospatial data. Today's Earth observation pipelines are fragmented, with models trained for single tasks on single sensors. We're taking a different approach, training foundation models that generalize across sensors, resolutions, and geospatial tasks natively. We are building the backbone for how machines interpret the planet. The applications span intelligence, climate monitoring, infrastructure mapping, and beyond. Huge thanks to Andrew Chen , Katia Ameri , Jordan Mazer , Mei En Chin , and the entire a16z speedrun team for building this program and for betting on us early. If you're working in Earth observation, Geospatial Intelligence, or Geospatial ML/Foundational Models, my DMs are open. For more details, refer to our website: locamage.com !

Today we're launching Luel Labs, our end-to-end multimodal data lab. Our research is powered by Luel's global network—leveraging 750,000+ contributors across 96+ countries to generate fully consented, quality-assured audio, video, and image data. First up — Breakthrough TTS for underrepresented languages from the tips of the Himalayas and across the Sahara. We're delivering the first commercial-grade TTS for Tibetan and Dzongkha, and outperforming existing Masri and Darija models. Alongside this effort, we’re driving foundational research to help the industry handle messy, real-world data—pioneering new approaches to 48kHz speaker separation, conversational overlap, STT modeling, data integrity, speech understanding and more.

🚀 Yann LeCun is back in venture capital. This time with a $100 million AI fund. The former Meta chief AI scientist has joined 224 Ventures , a new firm co-led by Google DeepMind ’s Oriol Vinyals and former AIX Ventures partner Shaun Johnson . The fund plans to write $1 million to $5 million cheques into early-stage AI startups working on applications, robotics and infrastructure The firm says that the next major AI companies will be built beyond chatbots — in physical intelligence, enterprise applications, core AI research and infrastructure. 👉 Read more here: https://lnkd.in/dbNHhtU8 #AI #VentureCapital #Startups #DeepTech #YannLeCun

Over the years, my Designing for the Human Body course has evolved to include more entrepreneurship. After watching Todd Roberts and Owen Kent found ATDev based on a class project, I realized I wanted to do more to support students interested in translating ideas into real-world impact. I'm excited to share that, as of July 1, I've taken on the role of Interim Faculty Director of the UC Berkeley Management, Entrepreneurship, & Technology (M.E.T.) program . Over the past month, I've had the opportunity to learn about the program's history from its co-founders/chairmen of the board, Michael Grimes and Theodore Kuh , and one thing has stood out immediately: the people. The M.E.T. team ( Chris Dito , Dawn K., Katie DuPlessis , and Jagreet Sekhon, M.A. ) knows every student personally and is deeply committed to helping them succeed. That commitment shows in the outcomes. By commencement, 100% of the Class of 2026 had secured their next step, whether graduate school or employment, and every continuing student seeking a summer internship or research opportunity had found a placement. I'm looking forward to working with our exceptional students, staff, alumni, and industry partners, and to helping continue the program's tradition of developing future technology and business leaders. 📸: Jagreet, Michael, and me at the M.E.T. Summer High School Program for students interested in engineering and business. #engineering #entrepreneurship
